name: glasser-seo-audit
description: SEO audit of your own website on real data from Ahrefs, Semrush, DataForSEO, Serpstat and SerpApi, with no subscription to any of them. Give a domain and get technical and on-page checks, rankings, keyword opportunities, backlinks, competitors and AI search visibility, scored and turned into a prioritised action plan. Run it again to see what changed. You see the estimated cost before it starts and pay per call through Glasser; failed calls and empty results cost $0.00.
